title: The Mire Line
setting: original mud world (placeholder name; not Mimban)

draws.name: The Cauldron Refinery
draws.make_up: A Droid-Factory-class gas refinery on stilts in a flooded strike crater (about 350 x 300 m), rim and spoil heaps as terrain
draws.story_reason: It turns bog gas into droid fuel for the whole front; its flare stacks are seen across the bog

draws.name: The Moraine Citadel
draws.make_up: A Droid-Factory-class citadel dug into the north moraine; the planet's ONE capstone interior is inside
draws.story_reason: The CIS front headquarters; its command galleries run the whole line

draws.name: The Esker Redoubt
draws.make_up: CIS Mini Fortress + Metal Trench Line + artillery on the only long gravel ridge in the west
draws.story_reason: The only firm high ground in the west; its guns command the west bog

draws.name: The Drain Locks
draws.make_up: CIS Fortress Dam across the Drain + pump house + bunkers
draws.story_reason: The lock keeps the CIS trenches drained and its crest road is the only heavy crossing of the Drain

draws.name: The Peat-Gas Works
draws.make_up: CIS Mining Complex + Large Fuel Depot + flare field on a cut-over peat bog
draws.story_reason: It taps the bog gas that feeds the Cauldron; taking it starves the refinery

draws.name: The Old Listening Post
draws.make_up: CIS Communications FOB + Giant Radar Dish on the south-west rise
draws.story_reason: A Republic listening post lost at the war's start; its dish now spies on the fleet. Retaking it gives the Republic eyes over the south
